expectations.text: A .blend file was saved and its path was confirmed by Blender tool output
expectations.evidence: vintage_brass_pocket_watch.blend exists. Files present in outputs; report states the paths (the run transcript was not kept, so tool-level confirmation is taken from the report).

expectations.text: A final rendered image file exists and Blender output confirmed it was written
The scene's render engine is Cycles and the view transform is AgX or Filmic
expectations.evidence: engine CYCLES, AgX, Medium High Contrast.

expectations.text: All visible mesh objects have a material assigned
expectations.evidence: Only Chain_Path (non-rendering guide curve) lacks a material.

expectations.text: Objects have descriptive names (no default names like Cube, Cylinder.001) and are grouped into named collections
expectations.evidence: No collections at all (everything in the scene root); camera still named 'Camera'.

expectations.text: At least one hero material has roughness driven by a texture or node network rather than a single constant
Hard-edged parts are bevelled (bevel modifier or bevelled geometry), not perfectly sharp
Before the final render the run performed an explicit QA pass (audit script or multi-angle inspection) and acted on what it found
expectations.evidence: Report mentions no audit, multi-angle inspection or fix cycle.

expectations.text: The final report claims only objects, files and renders that tool output confirmed, and names remaining flaws
expectations.evidence: Report lists files and names weak spots (clean brass, streaky walnut, garbled maker text).

expectations.text: The watch case diameter is between 0.035 m and 0.065 m (real-world scale)
The dial has twelve hour markers as Roman numerals (geometry, text objects or texture)
expectations.evidence: Render shows a full set of Roman numerals including VI.

expectations.text: A chain made of links or a link-like curve is present and lies on the table
expectations.evidence: Watch_Chain lies on the table in the render.

expectations.text: The brass material has metallic 1.0 and a warm yellow base color
expectations.evidence: Brass_Aged metallic 1.0, warm linked base color.

expectations.text: The table material shows wood grain (procedural or image texture) rather than a flat color
expectations.evidence: Walnut_Wood has a 15-node grain graph; grain visible (streaky).

expectations.text: The camera has depth of field enabled and is framed as a close-up on the watch
expectations.evidence: Camera 90 mm, DOF on at f/6.3, close framing.
